title: Penniston's 'sphere of influence' near the Rendlesham craft

tellings.quote: in and around this uh what Jim penniston called a sphere of influence where he felt like he was walking through water

plain: Near the craft reported in Rendlesham Forest in England in 1980, a US airman named Jim Penniston said he entered what he called a "sphere of influence", where walking felt like moving through water. A researcher named Mike Masters repeats this on the show without naming a source. It is told as a sign that the object changed the space around it.
